companies.name: Limpopo Cash and Carry
companies.distributes: Wholesale FMCG with large confectionery and biscuit, sweets and chocolate, and snacks categories (Cadbury chocolate, Chappies sweets, Lotus biscuits), plus groceries and household goods.
companies.channels_supplied: Retailers of all sizes in Limpopo, across South Africa and in most SADC countries, with B2B accounts and order-and-collect.
companies.fit_rationale: A Polokwane wholesaler trading since 1998 whose web shop lists hundreds of sweets, chocolate, biscuit and snack lines for retailers, a strong route into Limpopo's independent and township trade. Scale: clients across Limpopo, the rest of South Africa and most SADC countries; branch count and warehouse size not shown. Storage: cash and carry warehouse in Polokwane with a B2B web shop showing stock and order-for-collection.
what_they_do_well: Trading since 1998, supplying retailers across Limpopo, South Africa and most SADC countries.

companies.name: Arrow Cash and Carry
companies.distributes: Groceries with a dedicated confectionery department alongside cigarettes and general FMCG; brands not named on its website.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesalers, retailers, spaza shops and convenience stores in KwaZulu-Natal, plus export clients.
companies.fit_rationale: A Durban cash and carry trading since 2001 that sells confectionery to spaza shops, convenience stores and other retailers, giving Diablo a route into the KwaZulu-Natal traditional trade. Scale: not shown on its website; one site on Umgeni Road, Durban, serving the trade. Storage: cash and carry premises at 201 Umgeni Road, Durban.
what_they_do_well: Trading as a Durban cash and carry since 2001, supplying wholesalers, retailers, spaza shops and convenience stores.

companies.name: Salsabil Cash and Carry
companies.distributes: Bulk FMCG with a sweets and snacks category (Chappies confectionery, Truda, Spookies and Stylos snacks), plus beverages, bakery staples and household goods.
companies.channels_supplied: Spaza and township shops, independent retailers and supermarkets, reseller distribution partners and general wholesale traders in Gauteng.
companies.fit_rationale: A Germiston wholesaler whose sweets and snacks category supplies spaza shops, independent supermarkets and resellers, a direct route to the Gauteng township trade. Scale: not shown on its website (its counters are unfilled); one site in Germiston selling only to the trade. Storage: cash and carry warehouse at 130 High Street, Germiston, selling in bulk.
what_they_do_well: Supplies spaza shops, independent supermarkets and reseller distribution partners from one Germiston wholesale site.

companies.name: Musafir Cash & Carry
companies.distributes: Wholesale groceries and household goods with a snacks and confectionery collection: chocolates, sweets, biscuits, cookies and cakes in trade cases (Nestle Aero, Kit Kat and Lion bars, My-Chew sweets, Casa-Mia biscuits).
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale buyers from its Athlone cash and carry and its online store with delivery in Cape Town.
companies.fit_rationale: An Athlone wholesaler that sells branded chocolate, sweets and biscuits by the case, with an online catalogue of 1,705 lines that shows stock and prices. Scale: not shown on its website; one site in Athlone, Cape Town, and a large online shop with home delivery next to its wholesale trade. Storage: cash and carry at 4 Luxmi Street, Athlone, and a B2B web shop with stock and prices.
